newsitem.title: UK: BP, Shell indicated higher after U.S. rally.
newsitem.headline: BP, Shell indicated higher after U.S. rally.

text.p: Shares in British Petroleum and Shell Transport advanced in pre-market trading, lifted by a strong performance in U.S. oil stocks, dealers said.
At 0814 GMT, BP shares were were indicated 11-1/2p higher at 709, a fresh record high, while Shell shares were up 13-1/2p to 1018p in pre-market dealings.

U.S. oil shares rallied sharply overnight, with several closing at or near their 52-week highs, after an analyst with Dean Witter made bullish comments about several stocks in the group and said demand for crude oil remains strong nN0969737.

Shares in Chevron jumped $1-7/8 to 68-1/4, while shares in Texaco climbed $2-7/8 to 104-7/8, despite a pull back in crude oil prices. Shares in Mobil advanced $2-1/2 to $128-5/8 and shares in Exxon rallied $3-3/4 to $103-1/4.
